# Universal Honeypot Benchmarking Standard (UHBS)

> Open-source beta-status framework (v4.3.0, Apache-2.0) for vendor-neutral honeypot / deception evaluation (UHQS 0–100 + Safety Gate). Not a consortium standard.

This file is the **repository** agent index (AEO/GEO for coding assistants). The published site mirror is https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/llms.txt (landing) · https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/llms.txt (MkDocs)

## Essential

- [README](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/README.md): Project posture and quickstart
- [ROADMAP](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): Maturity plan; Phase 6 community goals unchecked
- [MAINTAINERS](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md): Single maintainer today
- [Landing hub](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/): React overview + published lab grades
- [MkDocs docs](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/): Specification, scorecards, conformance reports
- [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/CITATION.cff): How to cite

## Normative / machine-readable

- [Scoring formula](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/docs/specification/scoring-formula.md): UHQS + δ_C
- [uhqs_math.py](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/src/uhbs_core/uhqs_math.py): Single source of UHQS math
- [profile.schema.json](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/schemas/profile.schema.json): TPS schema
- [scorecard.schema.json](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/schemas/scorecard.schema.json): Scorecard schema
- [evidence-pack.schema.json](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/schemas/evidence-pack.schema.json): Evidence pack schema

## Implementation

- [uhbs_cli](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/tree/main/src/uhbs_cli): Validator CLI
- [uhbs_core](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/tree/main/src/uhbs_core): UHBS-Lab Modules A–F harness
- [uhbs_mcp](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/tree/main/src/uhbs_mcp): MCP server for AI hosts (stdio validate/score/fixtures)
- [CLI guide](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/docs/tooling/cli.md): Commands and integrity checks
- [MCP guide](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/docs/tooling/mcp.md): Cursor / Claude / VS Code config
- [MCP honeypot grading](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/docs/architecture/mcp-honeypot-grading.md): Live `uhbs-lab --protocol mcp` (not AI-host MCP)
- [server.json](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/server.json): MCP Registry metadata (stdio)
- [Conformance fixtures](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/tree/main/docs/conformance/fixtures): Proof scorecards only

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Guidance for coding agents working in this repo
- [GOVERNANCE.md](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md): Honest project notes (no fake committee)
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/mziqudhd92/uhbs-standard/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Report vulns via GitHub Security Advisories
- [Published site MCP docs](https://mziqudhd92.github.io/uhbs-standard/mkdocs/tooling/mcp/): Install + host config
